journey.title: Tab stays inside the upload dialog when it contains a hidden button
journey.goal: Tabbing past the last visible control wraps to the start of the dialog

plan.root_cause: The MicroModal library's getFocusableNodes() method includes hidden elements (like the .retry button with display:none) in the focusable nodes list. When tabbing from the last visible control (#upload), the focus trap logic sees the hidden #retry button as the last focusable node, so it doesn't trigger the wrap-around behavior, allowing focus to escape to page content (#help).
plan.repair_strategy: Modify getFocusableNodes() to filter out elements that are not visually rendered (display:none, visibility:hidden, opacity:0) or have aria-hidden="true", ensuring only perceivable controls participate in the focus trap.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key cycles within the dialog's visible controls per WCAG 2.1.1 and 2.4.3, preventing focus escape to page content when the dialog is open.
functional_risks: Minimal risk: only affects focus trapping logic in MicroModal
Could theoretically affect modals that intentionally use hidden-but-focusable elements (uncommon pattern)
verification_requirements: Existing keyboard journey passes: Tab from #upload wraps to #modal-close
Escape key closes dialog and returns focus to trigger
Initial focus lands on #filename when dialog opens
Shift+Tab from first focusable element wraps to last
